title: Cascata Golf Course
specs: Rees Jones designed course with dramatic elevation changes and postcard-worthy vistas
Ranked #2 Course You Can Play in Nevada by Golfweek
Caddies are required with one caddie per foursome unless arranged otherwise
Caddie gratuity recommended $40 per person, payable after round
Typical golf attire required: golf shirts, pants or walking shorts, soft spike or athletic shoes
Tee time reservations for up to 16 players can be made up to 120 days in advance
Groups of 17 or more require inquiry to sales team
Cascata can accommodate groups of 16-144 people for events

blurb: Cascata Golf Club features a Rees Jones designed course with dramatic elevation changes and stunning vistas. Golfers play 18 holes with a required caddie and shared golf cart included in the green fee. The course requires golf attire and has a standard pace of play of 4.5-5 hours.
extraNote: Rates are dynamic and subject to change; confirm at time of booking · Gratuity for forecaddies is additional and at guest discretion · Non-Cascata forecaddies/caddies not permitted; unauthorized caddying may result in removal · Outside food and beverage strictly prohibited
